description: Create one or more scheduled live streams in a single call (POST /lives), optionally recording into a resolved folder. Defaults like the dashboard: region us, quality_package hd, save_vod true. Refuses trial accounts and quality above the plan's maximum. Without stream_key_id the account's default stream key is used. dry_run=true (default) previews the lives that would be created.

folder_ref.description: Optional folder (name/ID/URL) to store recordings in

region.description: us (default) or br (lower delay for viewers in Brazil)

save_vod.description: Save the recording as a video (default true)

scheduled_at.description: Scheduled start: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM[:SS]. Without a zone it is Brasília time (UTC-3); add Z or ±HH:MM when the user is elsewhere.

stream_key_id.description: Stream key ID (panda_list_stream_keys); default key when omitted

name: panda_action_schedule_lives
title: Schedule Lives
